text.p: Cleanup continues along the Red River in the upper Plains of the USA and in southern Manitoba, Canada, near Winnepeg. The next chance for moderate rain in the area does not come until late in the week. Rainfall so far this month has averaged below normal.

Tropical cyclone 36s (Rhonda) is a significant risk to shipping in the southeast Indian Ocean. Top winds have decreased to 75 mph in the latest report with the system near 19s/100e. This system is expected to continue to weaken, and dissipate over open waters in the next 36-48 hours.

Tropical Cyclone 01B is an increasing risk to shipping in the Bay of Bengal. Top winds are near 50 mph in the latest report, with the system near 6n/91e. It is expected to continue strengthening while heading northwestward, with top winds possibly reaching 100-110 mph in 48 hours.
